short_scenes.caption: A cry in the night.
short_scenes.narration: On a cold spring night, a cry filled the village. A baby boy.

short_scenes.caption: They named him Leo.
short_scenes.narration: They named him Leo. Brave like a lion. John promised he would protect him, always.

short_scenes.caption: Years passed.
short_scenes.narration: Years passed. Leo grew fast, curious, fearless, always running ahead.

short_scenes.caption: Leo went too far.
short_scenes.narration: One evening, Leo chased a rabbit into the forest. Too far. And he wasn't alone.

short_scenes.caption: Who is waiting in the forest? Guess below!
short_scenes.narration: Who is waiting in the forest? Guess below! Follow so you don't miss the next part.
